summary: Solid production-ready code. Workflow properly uses pinned action refs (actions/checkout@v4), least-privilege permissions (contents: read), and correct job ordering (cleanup-plan needs unit-tests). PowerShell has comprehensive error handling, parameter validation with ValidateRange, and proper exit codes. Minor issues: (1) Missing explicit Set-StrictMode in ArtifactCleanup.psm1 modules—rely on -ErrorActionPreference alone; (2) Get-ArtifactCleanupPlan is large (~80 lines) with three independent policy blocks that could factor into helpers; (3) Run-ActTests.ps1 asserts on fragile string-matching ('Job succeeded' pattern-match, line ~184). Code excels in naming clarity, comment quality, and separation of concerns. Scenario-driven design aids testability.
